title: Rabbi Abbahu bar Nagri
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: This is the reading in Peah 5:3. Hyman considers the plain sense more likely: Rabbi Yose, son of Rabbi Biyon, raised the difficulty, and Rabbi Abbahu addressed him as bar Nagri and answered his difficulty.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied spelling ביון is rendered Biyon rather than silently changed to Bun. Hyman’s preferred analysis makes bar Nagri an address to the questioner.

The named passage was positively matched in the returned Jerusalem Talmud Peah chapter 5, paragraphs corresponding to digital 5:4: a preceding paragraph names Rabbi Yosei beRabbi Bun and the next reads Rabbi Abbahu bar Nagri. The supplied 5:3 and Biyon are retained as Hyman’s wording. His preferred interpretation treats bar Nagri as an address to the questioner; the checked text does not itself adjudicate that interpretation.
